judgments.reason: No model statement explains inclusion of the three-coin commission before payment or shows a bid exceeding available coins winning; the model actions only describe bidding and settling, not the claimed rule-order mechanism.
The model never articulated that waiting reveals already-committed sealed rival bid values before committing; its play descriptions do not claim or explain this information-timing mechanism.
The model only says 'Settle now to lock in the current tie' and does not articulate or demonstrate that close settles the game despite unauctioned lots as a distinct rule discrepancy.

The transcript shows a catalog purchase producing an unexpected net coin/score change (trace flagged round 4), but the model_articulation did not explain that the three-coin auction commission is being applied to catalog buys, so the mechanism was not articulated or claimed.
